scenario_A_casual_daytime.findings: Editorial Minimal look composed from neutral linen shirt + tailored wool trousers + derby shoes. Rationale grounded in volume balance and clean neutral base.

scenario_B_smart_casual.findings: Tailored trousers and polo pairing matches Work / Office occasion tags without attribute fabrication.

scenario_C_date_night.findings: Elevated accents / outerwear integrated cleanly for evening context.

scenario_D_hot_weather_summer.findings: Unlayered breathable top + bottom + shoes evaluated as weather-suitable for 86°F. Heavy outerwear omitted.

scenario_E_cooler_weather_outfit.findings: Trench coat layer validated for 48°F cooler conditions. Unlayered state correctly flagged.

scenario_F_sparse_wardrobe.findings: Missing shoe in 2-piece closet triggers honest 'Personal Wardrobe Required' guidance without placeholder fabrication.

scenario_G_interchangeable_wardrobe_swap.findings: Swapping top from Linen Shirt to Navy Polo and shoes to White Sneakers immediately recomputes rationale and compatibility without model re-inference.

usability_findings.touch_targets: PASS — Added 8-12px hitSlop to Swap, Remove, Close, and Feedback buttons to satisfy >= 44x44px touch guidelines.
usability_findings.whole_card_tappability: PASS — Wrapped garment photos in LookFlatLay in touchable containers so tapping the item opens swap sheet immediately.
usability_findings.candidate_pills: PASS — Added minHeight: 36px and vertical centering to candidate switcher pills for thumb ergonomics.

visual_findings.grid_balance: PASS — Replaced empty colPlaceholder with an interactive 'Add Accessory (Optional)' dashed tile, restoring 2x2 grid visual balance.
visual_findings.single_item_guidance: PASS — Added contextual helper in PieceSwapModal when category contains only 1 item.
visual_findings.figma_tokens: PASS — #F9F9F8 background, #FFFFFF cards, #111111 typography, restrained borders, zero neon glow.

issues_discovered.description: Shoes card had an empty whitespace column next to it when no accessory was selected, making the layout lopsided.
issues_discovered.resolution: Replaced colPlaceholder with interactive 'Add Accessory (Optional)' dashed tile.

issues_discovered.description: Garment swap action was only triggerable by tapping the tiny 'Swap' pill, requiring pixel-hunting.
issues_discovered.resolution: Made the full garment image container tappable and added hitSlop to the Swap pill.

issues_discovered.description: No guidance in PieceSwapModal when user has only 1 piece in that category.
issues_discovered.resolution: Added single-piece guidance note informing user they are wearing their only piece in that category.
